thread:
jules_infra: heads up — OrchidTech sent a revised manifest. 18 H200s have been advanced into an earlier shipment (ETA 2025-03-02) but 6 are flagged 'inspection hold' pending RMA swaps.

nina_prod: which region are the advanced units bound for? we planned those for eu-north cluster.

jules_infra: 12 -> eu-north, 6 -> ap-southeast. the 6 on hold show 'inspection: possible DOA' and vendor notes 'awaiting serial replacement and export docs'.

alex_sourcing: any immediate cost impact from splitting the wave? we need delta to run landed cost.

jules_infra: OrchidTech quoted +7% for split + a one-time crossdock fee. asked them for AWB numbers and insured amount.

logistics-bot: Ticket created: INF-5090 — orchidtech-split-rma-hold. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-5090

riley_support: can we request temporary loaners from OrchidTech? last-minute loaners avoided a canary rollback before.

alex_sourcing: ask but push to waive handling for first 3 units. negotiate.

jules_infra: vendor reply: "Loaner availability: up to 6 units for 10 business days. Loaner handling fee: $950/unit. RMA SLA: 4-8 business days for serial swaps. Return freight: covered only if vendor-confirmed DOA; customs re-export docs are on client."

riley_support: eu-north customs re-export is slow. recommend engaging broker BlueHarbor now. any objections?

nina_prod: +1 BlueHarbor. also we should plan canary = 5% and enable fallback routing to 30b quantized model in Console if immediate capacity drops.

alex_sourcing: pricing note: uplift 7% + $950 handling per loaner (if used). if we take loaners, we should reserve nodes via tag `vendor:loaner` and pin to cluster to avoid autoscaler evictions.

jules_infra: decision window: vendor needs confirmation by tomorrow 11:00 PT to lock AWB and depot pickup. options: A) accept split + loaners (pay uplift + handling), B) accept split no loaners, C) decline split and keep original ETA (risk pushing rollout).

riley_support: ops prefers A to avoid customer impact.

nina_prod: lean A but reduce canary to 5% until loaners cleared. ops, ensure autoscaler policy enforces reserve.

logistics-bot: INF-5090 updated: decision=A, assigned to alex_sourcing, finance-notify tag added.

alex_sourcing: i'll confirm with OrchidTech and ask for consolidated invoice, AWB, and a written note confirming no Huawei parts in the shipment (we had a customs snag last quarter).

jules_infra: once AWB is posted i'll create `rma-return-label` in the ops queue and schedule loaner pickup (48h notice). also reminder for oncall: if vendor marks units DOA, mark return priority: express.

riley_support: quick checklist for logistics:```
- Confirm AWB + insured value
- Open RMA case with photos and attach to INF-5090
- Schedule loaner pickup window (req 48h notice)
- Engage BlueHarbor broker for re-export docs
- Tag loaner nodes `vendor:loaner` and pin capacity in k8s
- Finance: account for +7% uplift + handling fees
```

alex_sourcing: negotiating loaner handling — asking OrchidTech to waive fees for first 3 loaners or reduce to $500/unit. will update when they respond.

jules_infra: good. ping infra-oncall when AWB lands. :white_check_mark:

logistics-bot: Reminder set: follow-up in 8 hours for AWB and loaner confirmation.
